tuning_rules.objective: plug-in marginal likelihood of the fold's training observations under the daily state-space fit
tuning_rules.tie_break: ascending walk variance, then house scale, then covariance multiplier; the first maximum wins
tuning_rules.boundary: an optimum at either end of an axis is recorded and requires a documented grid expansion with a repeat of every affected development check
tuning_rules.per_institute_variance: not tuned in v1-development-1; a per-institute observation variance requires older-fold evidence first

coverage_rules.development_window: coverage evidence reads only fieldwork ending by the last development fold cutoff, so the reserved 2022 comparison and the prospective 2026 window stay outside it
coverage_rules.supported_dates: the outermost collection dates of the eligible observations the period's own roster composes completely, taken from corrected history rather than a publication-time fold
coverage_rules.gap: the longest run between consecutive observation midpoints inside the supported window; a longer run splits or ends support rather than being bridged
coverage_rules.stability: refit with both supported boundaries pulled in by each shift and compare the smoothed daily composition of every modeled component over the interior, burning in the same number of days at each end; the largest movement in percentage points must stay within the maximum
coverage_rules.failure: a failed rule leaves the individual estimate unavailable while the source observations are retained; it never lowers a rule
coverage_rules.parameters: the last development fold's tuned point for the period; its tuning gate carries into the coverage gate, so no result here is a release value

uncertainty_rules.draws: final_draws joint draws of the smoothed ilr state on every estimated day, not only on the final day, so a historical interval carries the same Monte Carlo precision as the headline
uncertainty_rules.generator: java.util.Random and its specified nextGaussian, whose algorithm and StrictMath calls the Java specification fixes, so a rerun on another architecture reproduces every draw
uncertainty_rules.seeding: each day draws from its own stream, seeded by the leading eight bytes of SHA-256 of '<periodId>|<date>|<seed>' read big-endian, so a day's draws never depend on how many days a run computes or on the order threads finish them
uncertainty_rules.transform: every draw is transformed to percent shares before any averaging; the reported mean is the arithmetic mean of transformed draws and never the transform of the mean state
uncertainty_rules.quantile: linear interpolation between the order statistics at h = (n-1)p on one component's sorted draws; marginal interval endpoints are never summed
uncertainty_rules.precision: repeat the whole run with the registered seed and its successors and report the largest movement of any mean or interval endpoint; the manifest resolves no tolerance for it, so the spread is recorded evidence rather than a gate
uncertainty_rules.reproduction: a rerun at the same seed must reproduce every retained draw exactly; the run records the seed, roster, basis, input rows, parameters, implementation digest and runtime versions needed to repeat it

publication_rules.point_estimate: the daily point estimate of a component is the arithmetic mean of its transformed joint draws, the same number uncertainty_rules.transform registers; the transform of the mean state is an internal diagnostic and is never published
publication_rules.one_pass: a published day's mean, lower and upper are read from one pass over that day's draws, so the point estimate and the interval around it describe one sample rather than two runs
publication_rules.resolution: published shares and interval endpoints are quoted to publication.decimals decimal places, chosen so a quoted digit does not move with the draw seed; the estimator keeps every digit it drew and the resolution applies where a number is published

remainder_rules.membership: support outside the fixed eight parties S, M, SD, V, C, KD, L and MP; FI and the residual are combined only where the roster keeps FI separate, since OTHER already contains FI everywhere else
remainder_rules.summary: the remainder is summed inside each joint draw and only then averaged and cut into quantiles, so an interval endpoint is never the sum of two marginal endpoints
remainder_rules.draws: the same per-day streams the component summaries read, so the remainder and the components describe one set of draws rather than two runs
remainder_rules.boundaries: the remainder is cut at the same separate fits, unsupported gaps and centering-reference changes as the daily history, and a change spanning any of them is suppressed rather than presented as movement
remainder_rules.elections: an official result is grouped into the period's own components before it is displayed against that period, and its comparable remainder combines FI and the residual in every period so the aggregate means the same thing across a roster change; election results are references, never observations

diagnostics_rules.held_out: every eligible poll with a known publication date after the fold cutoff and within score_horizon_days of it, composed in the period's own roster; a poll the roster cannot compose is excluded with its reason and counted, never scored as zero
diagnostics_rules.candidates: the midpoint candidate at the parameters the tuning run resolved for that fold, the recency baseline of the same training set and roster, and the ilr-window reference tuned independently on the same training data and the same frozen grid
diagnostics_rules.prediction: one joint predictive density per poll, from the training fit alone: no held-out poll updates the fit, and a held-out window that closes before the last training observation still conditions on it
diagnostics_rules.score: the multivariate Gaussian log density of the poll's own transformed composition, including state, house-effect and sampling uncertainty and their cross-covariance, through a Cholesky solve and a log determinant
diagnostics_rules.coverage: marginal composition intervals from score_draws joint draws of that same predictive distribution, transformed one draw at a time; counted per party and poll, and including the observed poll noise
diagnostics_rules.draws: each scored poll draws from its own stream, seeded by the leading eight bytes of SHA-256 of '<periodId>|<cutoff>|<candidate>|<row>|<seed>' read big-endian
diagnostics_rules.misfit: standardized composition residuals and mean log scores pooled and by party, institute and fieldwork-length band; whitened ilr residuals carry the autocorrelation and the pair dependence, since the model makes them independent standard normals
diagnostics_rules.sensitivity: the poll-count centering rerun and one rerun per institute left out of the fit, both compared against the published equal-institute run on the days both estimate; a movement over 10 percentage points is disclosed beside the number and does not itself block release
diagnostics_rules.gate: at least eight scored folds per roster, a strictly positive mean paired log score against the recency baseline, a reference difference no worse than one paired standard error at the frozen lag of three, and pooled coverage inside predictive_coverage95 and predictive_coverage50; an unscored fold blocks the aggregate rather than being dropped

resource_measurement.drift_poll_selection: the last eligible development poll from each institute, ordered by midpoint then source row
resource_measurement.correction: move 0.1 percentage points from OTHER to M in each selected poll; removing the row measures deletion and its reverse measures addition
resource_measurement.runtime_scope: one production-shaped corrected-history, joint-component uncertainty and comparable-remainder run; database setup and evidence parsing excluded
resource_measurement.memory_scope: sum of the JVM peak-used heap pools after their counters are reset immediately before the measured run
resource_measurement.performance_gate: the ten-second recompute target is measured and reported but is not an unconditional release gate

election_audit2022.row_identity: one-based CSV physical line; SHA-256 of UTF-8 row excluding newline
election_audit2022.candidate_selection: 2010-01-01 <= collectPeriodFrom <= collectPeriodTo <= 2022-09-10 AND PublDate not in ['', 'NA'] AND PublDate <= 2022-09-10; compare ISO dates lexically; apply versioned eligibility rules before fitting, retaining exclusions

outcome.precision: Use the exposed official two-decimal percentage fixture, not recomputed vote-count shares. OTHER is exactly 100 minus the eight displayed percentages in decimal arithmetic. Preserve this rounding in audit reporting.

prospective2026.source_rule: first complete archived snapshot captured after cutoff, restrict publication and collection end to cutoff; archive bytes and eligibility before reading result
